name: Processo di validazione
description: Le parole del processo: piani, campioni, analisi, rilascio.

terms.definition: The document that lists what to test, how and when.
terms.example: I wrote the test plan for the new ADC.

terms.definition: The setup of instruments, boards and scripts used for testing.
terms.example: We automated the test bench with Python.

terms.definition: How much of the specification or the code the tests check.
terms.example: Our coverage of the CAN features is now ninety-five percent.

terms.definition: Unusual conditions at the edges of the specification.
terms.example: Most bugs hide in the corner cases.

terms.definition: Process, voltage and temperature: the conditions that change a chip's behaviour.
terms.example: We characterized the oscillator across PVT.

terms.definition: Measuring how a device really behaves across conditions and samples.
terms.example: The characterization showed a margin of ten percent.

terms.definition: The first tests on new chips, to make them work for the first time.
terms.example: During the silicon bring-up we found a clock issue.

terms.definition: The official list of known bugs in a chip and their workarounds.
terms.example: This issue is documented in the errata sheet.

terms.definition: Finding the real origin of a problem, not just its symptoms.
terms.example: The root cause analysis took two weeks.

terms.definition: Running old tests again to check that nothing broke.
terms.example: The nightly regression runs four hundred tests.

terms.definition: A single test with steps and an expected result.
terms.example: Each requirement has at least one test case.

terms.definition: The rules that decide if a test passed.
terms.example: The pass/fail criteria come from the datasheet limits.

terms.definition: The document with the specifications of a component.
terms.example: According to the datasheet, the maximum current is twenty milliamps.

terms.definition: A document that describes exactly how something must work.
terms.example: The specification requires a startup time below one millisecond.

terms.definition: One of the chips or boards used for testing.
terms.example: We tested thirty samples from three lots.

terms.definition: A group of chips made together.
terms.example: One lot showed higher leakage.

terms.definition: The thin disk of silicon on which chips are made.
terms.example: Each wafer has about two thousand dies.

terms.definition: The percentage of good chips out of all chips made.
terms.example: The yield improved after the process change.

terms.definition: The lab study of a failed part to understand what broke.
terms.example: We sent the part to failure analysis.

terms.definition: The final approval that the work is complete.
terms.example: We need the validation sign-off before the release.

terms.definition: The moment the final chip design is sent to production.
terms.example: The tape-out is planned for March.

terms.definition: A meeting to check a design before going on.
terms.example: I presented the test results at the design review.

terms.definition: Using scripts and tools so tests run without manual work.
terms.example: Automation reduced the test time from days to hours.

terms.definition: A small program that automates a task.
terms.example: I wrote a script to control the climatic chamber.

terms.definition: A document that summarizes the results.
terms.example: The test report is ready for review.

terms.definition: The tool where bugs and tasks are recorded.
terms.example: I opened a ticket in the issue tracker.

terms.definition: How easy it is to make a problem happen again.
terms.example: The reproducibility is low: one failure every hundred runs.

terms.definition: A way to avoid a problem without fixing its cause.
terms.example: The errata gives a software workaround.

terms.definition: Tests that prove a product is reliable enough to be sold.
terms.example: The automotive qualification follows AEC-Q100.

terms.definition: How long and how well a product works without failing.
terms.example: The reliability tests run for one thousand hours.

terms.definition: Meeting a standard or a regulation.
terms.example: The board passed the EMC compliance tests.

terms.definition: Checking that a design matches its specification, often before silicon.
terms.example: Design verification is done in simulation.
